lines.text: Space Tourism
Text8A
Do you think space tourism could become mass market?
Can you imagine that in a few years, we could be using
spaceships as we use passenger airplanes. A number of
companies are getting ready to send people out in the
space. Commercial operators are now competing to
operate scheduled services to the outer limits of the
Earth's atmosphere. This is termed as'Space Tourism'
Space tourism is used to describe space travel for
recreational or leisure purposes.What was once only a
dream is now becoming a reality.
Professor Richard Crowther, Technical Adviserto the UK
Space Agency, predicted that in the future space trips
would become a lot more regular and a lot cheaper. "lt
will be very expensive at first, but the technology that

21st century, families might go for a holiday on the

but the rapid development of technology may mean
these predictions are a possibility in the years to come.
